title: JobDescriptor
description: Persistent, safe summary of a background job without source rows or local paths.

project_id.description: UUID v7 project identity that owns the job.

status.description: Current lifecycle status such as QUEUED or RUNNING.

correlation_id.description: UUID v7 trace identity for the job mutation.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the job was created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the latest job change.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when execution started.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when execution finished.

progress_message.description: Safe Indonesian progress message without source data.

error_message.description: Safe actionable failure message without raw errors.

error_retriable.description: Whether retrying the job is safe and permitted.
